<parameter=code>
def ppos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
    return None
for i in range(3):
    action(['RIGHT'])
    print(f"R{i+1}:",ppos(current_frame),"changed=",last_action_result.get('board_changed'))
# check ascii around player row to see if it's at the right edge
rows=current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
p=ppos(current_frame)
if p:
    r0=p[0]
    print(f"row {r0} cols 40-56: {rows[r0][40:56]}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
